comment: Round 111 registry — source of truth for casewhyhub.com's page list. Adding a page here + a content/<id>.html fragment + rerunning scripts/generate.mjs regenerates every page's header/footer/nav, home's cards, and sitemap.xml consistently. No runtime build step exists on this static site (Vercel serves the committed HTML directly) so this script is run manually, matching round 94's original hand-authored approach but removing the copy-paste-drift risk across 7+ near-identical files.
